title: Common reusable schema fragments
description: Reusable patterns referenced by other engine schemas. Per ADR-0006, ADR-0012, ADR-0013.

Identifier.description: An entity id. Lowercase snake_case. Must match the directory or registry key name.

ReferenceURN.description: Typed cross-reference per ADR-0006. Form: <kind>:<id>. Resolves via Manifest Index.

RuntimeReferenceURN.description: Reference URN that may point to a procgen-generated runtime instance. Validator does not check resolution at authoring time. Used for fields like ruler/heir where the value may be hand-authored OR procgen.

TemplateParameter.description: A placeholder for runtime substitution. Used in storylet preconditions and effects. Form: $name.

DotPathParameter.description: A template parameter with dot-path access into a runtime object. Used in storylet effects and dialogue refs. Forms: $sub_faction.ruler, $sub_faction.elite_overproduction_ratio. The validator accepts the syntax; runtime resolution validates that the path exists on the referenced object.

SubstitutionPattern.description: A string template with curly-brace placeholders resolved against the appropriate name table or runtime context. Used in name patterns and lore patterns. Examples: 'Kingdom of {place_root}', '{first} {family_name}', 'The {name} Choir'. Valid placeholder names depend on context: name_tables expose {first}, {family_name}, {place_root}, {epithet}; sub_faction lore_pattern exposes {ruler_name}, {capital_name}, {founding_year}.

RuntimeExpression.description:
An inline expression evaluated against world state at runtime. Used by storylet salience. The expression language supports: numeric literals, basic arithmetic (+ - * /), parentheses, and dotted-path reads against the world-state namespace.

Documented namespace (see expression_namespace.md):
  sub_faction.N, sub_faction.S, sub_faction.W, sub_faction.E, sub_faction.solidarity, sub_faction.treasury, sub_faction.elite_overproduction_ratio
  tile.cosmic_horror_susceptibility, tile.biome_id
  world.season, world.time_in_days, world.cosmic_horror_intensity_avg
  npc.affinity_with_player

The validator accepts the string but does not parse it; the engine's expression evaluator validates references against the runtime namespace and emits errors for undefined variables.

TagId.description: A free-form tag identifier. Tags are informally documented per-project; the validator does not enforce a central registry. Use tags for filtering and storylet preconditions; do not rely on tag semantics that aren't documented in the project's README.

PathRef.description: A filesystem path relative to the project root. Validator checks the file exists.

ScriptRef.description: A reference to a script file used in place of inline data. Used in Storylet effects and salience.

FileRef.description: A reference to a content file used in place of inline text. Used in Storylet content.

AssetRef.description: A reference to a catalog asset by content hash. Resolved by the asset catalog. Per the asset pipeline (Section 3.4).

Drive.description: A weighted goal or aversion held by an NPC. Per ADR-0012.

NumberRange.description: An inclusive numeric range used in Template variability fields.
